effects.description: Cold detail waits for transport and displays live updates; no cache data is invented.
Warm detail renders cache within open after migration, then stays subscribed to fresh observations.
Closing a warm activation releases its watch and prevents later network output.
Switching before network delivery retains only B and its subscription.
A delivery opens C inline; warm maintenance delivery occurs before outer watch returns, whereas baseline delivery occurs later.
A delivery closes inline; a returned watch of the departed activation must not reopen or leak.
Inline delivery reopens A; the same key denotes a different activation and must retain exactly one live watch.
Ordinary close/reopen of the same record creates one fresh activation with no stale subscription.
A cold network callback opens B after the original open returned; successor remains live.
A warm compliance consumer must wait for a real network observation in every authorization variant.
Detail and compliance share a key and repository but retain different delivery and lifetime policies.
Recent preview preserves network delivery and hide cleanup; cache migration is separately authorized.
Preview hide then inspect creates a fresh watch and consistent delivery policy.
Recent preview has one consistent cache/network policy with live delivery and hide cleanup.
Recent preview presents cache during inspect; this is an authorization scope extension.
